title: Notable neighbor probability
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let $T$ be a table of functions from the $q$-dimensional sign cube to $[-1,1]$, let $\varepsilon\in\mathbb R$, and fix a vertex $v$ and coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,q\}$. The notable neighbor probability is the expected indicator, for a uniformly selected neighbor of $v$, that the image of $i$ under the inverse edge permutation is a notable coordinate at the neighboring vertex.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$
$T$ is a table of functions from the $q$-dimensional sign cube to $[-1,1]$
